recommendations.name: DRS-OSS (drs-llm)
recommendations.description: The closest open-source analogue to Meta's DRS: a Docker-deployable, fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B PR risk scorer with an API, web dashboard and GitHub App, though it is an independent reimplementation (not Meta's code), needs a large GPU, and I could not confirm its license.

recommendations.name: jit-dp-llm (DRS-OSS replication package)
recommendations.description: The fine-tuning scripts behind DRS-OSS, useful if you want to train the risk model on your own repository's history instead of using the pretrained one.

recommendations.name: JITBot
recommendations.description: A GitHub application for CI/CD that flags risky commits, explains why, and suggests mitigations, but I only found a demo page (no repo link), so its availability and license are unverified.
